notes.title: Update notes for 7.6.4
notes.content:
- Music and sound effects volume controls have been added to all pause screens.
- Various minor fixes and overall performance improvements.

notes.title: Update Notes For April 11
notes.content: -Staves ignore 4% of the target’s armor, while grimoires bypass 8% as usual. These values are subject to change in the future if balancing adjustments are needed.

notes.title: New PvP mode available!
notes.content:
Duels, our new real-time PvP mode, are now available in open beta! Challenge friends and other players in the Tavern!

Ranked matches with random matchmaking are coming soon! Get ready to duel and share your thoughts!

This beta phase aims to gather valuable feedback to help us improve the new mode further. We are still working on enhancing our servers, so some players might experience high ping rates. More servers worldwide are on the way!

Patch-notes:

- Hammers, maces, and some heavy axes now knock enemies back on impact.
- New Power-Up: Instant Gust is now available in the Tavern! This powerful ability pushes enemies back with a strong gust every time you attack.
- Exciting Update: Most of the third-party licensed music from the campaign has been replaced with brand-new original tracks! This means content creators can now monetize Magic Rampage videos without worrying about music licensing issues.

notes.title: Update Notes for June 30th
notes.content:
-When affected by frost, repeatedly pressing jump button now reduces freeze time.
-Grimoire's magic strike now has the ability to partially bypass some of the target's armor.
-Spears of any element and all other light elemental weapons will no longer suffer a significant damage reduction when piercing through targets or shields.
-Tonic of Invulnerability and Pepper Brew power-ups now also increase user's armor.
-Power-ups no longer allowed during the initial play-through of a Campaign Dungeon in Rampage Mode, to enhance the challenge and encourage skill-based progression.
-Minor bug fixes and tweaks.

[list]
[*] New eye colors now available for customization
[*] Minor security enhancements and bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Skins and New Game+!
notes.content:
We're super exited to bring you new epic class-skins to customize your characters! You can exchange your rank points for unique skins at the end of each Season!

Get a sneak peak at all skins for the current season in the Prize Room.

And there's more! You can now start a new game on Rampage Mode! Rampage Mode brings the true hard mode that will put the best player's skills to the test! With legendary items as a reward!

[h3]What's new on Steam:[/h3]

Thanks to feedback from the massive amount of new players who joined Steam, we made a number of under-the-hood adjustments to make the single player campaign more challenging and rewarding on PC.

Listening to community feedback, we've also added the possibility to customize keyboard controls on PC.

notes.title: The Fabled Chambers
notes.content:
Prepare to face the fiercest bosses in the deadly chambers for some epic loot!

[h3]WEEKLY DUNGEONS - Live ops![/h3]

A new Dungeon every week! Each week, players will be presented with unique challenges and epic rewards from the Golden Chest!

Weekly Dungeons offer time and star challenges in three levels of difficulty. Additionally, you get extra Rank points every day you complete it.
